dedupe_keys.name: saudi ministry of municipalities and housing open files stormwater drainage networks 2016 public toilets 2018 building permits q1 2021

description: Ministry of Municipalities and Housing (MOMAH), Saudi Arabia publishes municipal statistical files of the ministry: the stormwater drainage and flood-danger works of 2016 by regional secretariat (amanah), with main and secondary network lengths in metres (a total of 5,203,394 m across 17 secretariats in the file), numbers and lengths of retaining walls; the number of public toilets by secretariat at the end of 2018; the building permits issued in the first quarter of 2021 by permit type, secretariat and municipality; and four quarterly workbooks of 2021 to 2022 whose file names refer to reports on the urban landscape (المشهد الحضري), which were not read. Coverage: Saudi Arabia by regional secretariat and, for permits, by municipality; single-year snapshots (2016, 2018, Q1 2021) with the newest file dated 2022. Format and access: CSV and XLSX files, free and without registration from the ministry open data page. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Not stated on the pages read; cost: free. Caveats: the files are one-off statistical snapshots, not maintained series; stormwater lengths are totals per secretariat with no network geometry; the permit workbook was read only as far as its first rows and the four urban-landscape workbooks were not opened; no licence is stated on the pages read; the file listing is on the ministry open data page with 8 files found. Simulation uses: national and regional stormwater-network extent for drainage and flash-flood exposure studies, and municipal permit activity for building-stock growth models. Related catalogue records: OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
